title: Au-dessus de la boucherie
premise: Papa and Maman are at the upstairs counter. The clerk is slicing a ham, and a man at the next table is eating bread.

lines.speaker: Maman
lines.fr: On est bien, au-dessus de la boucherie.
lines.en: This is a good spot, above the butcher's.

lines.speaker: Papa
lines.fr: Oui. Le charcutier coupe le jambon. Je prends un steak.
lines.en: Yes. The deli clerk is cutting the ham. I'll have a steak.

lines.speaker: Maman
lines.fr: Moi, je regarde les crevettes. Et cette huître, avec sa perle.
lines.en: I'm looking at the shrimp. And this oyster, with its pearl.

lines.speaker: Papa
lines.fr: Tu as vu le poisson ? Ses écailles brillent, à côté du cerf-volant.
lines.en: Did you see the fish? Its scales shine, next to the kite.

lines.speaker: Maman
lines.fr: Le requin reste sur la glace. Il ne mord rien.
lines.en: The shark stays on the ice. It isn't biting anything.

lines.speaker: Papa
lines.fr: Et lui, le mangeur, il a son pain. On redescend quand tu veux.
lines.en: And him, the eater, he has his bread. We can go back down when you want.
